name: Senkou Yuugeki Oukatai YURI ~Denshi no Seirei-tachi~
original_name: 先攻遊撃桜花隊・YURI～電子の聖霊たち～
source:
Continent is a battlefield between states. 
Alliance Forces defeat Imperial forces in decisive battle. Imperial army girl trained in secret arts becomes the last trump card for disjointed forces.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/04/vn-of-month-july-2002-viper-rsr.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
大陸是諸國之間的戰場。聯盟軍在決定性戰役中擊敗帝國軍。受過秘傳技術訓練的帝國軍少女，成了殘部最後的王牌。
